issues.description: Radar chart with 6 dimensions (Warmth, Complexity, Organic, Layered, Heritage, Character) is completely absent from the visible UI
issues.root_cause: The radar chart component is either not rendered, conditionally hidden, or placed below the fold in the 'YOUR STYLE DNA' / Fingerprint Map section. It may be a client-only component causing hydration mismatch, or the component import/render is missing from apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors (7 instances) causing entire root to fall back to client rendering. 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times.
issues.root_cause: Dynamic/random values (likely style name, color palette, or radar chart scores) are being computed differently on server vs client. This is likely caused by Math.random() or Date.now() calls at render time, or localStorage access during SSR in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx or a child component.

issues.description: Tweak input field is missing from the visible screen — expected per spec but not rendered
issues.root_cause: The tweak/refinement input field is either not implemented or not rendered in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx

Ensure useEffect/useState are imported so dynamic data can be deferred to client-only rendering, preventing SSR/hydration text mismatch.
